title: Complete the Pauli basis to transfer the original unknown state
statement: Ordered capture windows and product attenuation yield a finite local decoder valid for every external reference.

LetC_j={I,-Q,-P,QP},D_((a,k),j)=(C_j)_(ak)^*/sqrt2. Pauli completeness makesD unitary and (I_S tensorD)*(sum_j C_j|psi>|j>/2)=Phi_plus_(S,Raux) tensor|psi>_(Rout). Linearity preserves arbitrary entanglement with inaccessibleA. Source is then discardable;input is not cloned.

The desired vacuum-trajectory branch implements p0*identity,p0=4exp(-mu)u^4,mu=gamma T,with input-independent GOOD-BRANCH weight. With loss/inefficient detection,the full success probability need not be input-independent;the later completely-positive-error bound is required. Vacuum of the LOST field is only a proof branch,not a measured herald.
